report:
### Screen: `products-retatrutide-390` (390px)
- **Extra promotional pill below nav:** The preview renders a green pill button reading *“Get your free peptide safety test →”* between the nav links and the page title. The design shows only the full-width green top banner; no secondary pill exists below the nav on mobile.
- **Methodology badge container missing:** The design shows the methodology elements (*“Purity Focused”*, green *“purity 99.5%+”* pill, gray *“dose ±35%”* pill) enclosed in a bordered rounded rectangle with a dropdown chevron on the right, and *“View methodology”* sits below that box. The preview shows the same text/pills inline without a containing border and places *“View methodology”* on the same horizontal line.
- **Subtitle copy / capitalization:** The design subtitle reads *“methodology · Purity focus”* (lowercase *focus*). The preview reads *“methodology · Purity Focused”* (title case with an extra *-ed*).
- **Vendor list empty state vs. card rows:** The design shows eight populated vendor card-rows with rank numbers, colored initials, vendor names, *“Verified Supplier”* badges, *“Get report”* links, prices, and colored purity pills. The preview shows only an error message (*“Unable to load vendors…”*) and lacks the card-style row layout entirely.
- **Test history table structure missing:** The design shows column headers (*DATE, RESULT, TEST*) and ten populated rows beneath the section header/stats. The preview renders only the section title, stats line, badge, and an error message; no table headers or rows are visible.
- **COA badge iconography:** The design uses a green dot (●) before *“COA-BACKED LAB TESTS”*. The preview uses a document/page icon instead.

### Screen: `products-retatrutide-744` (744px)
- **Extra promotional pill below nav:** Same as mobile—the preview renders the green *“Get your free peptide safety test →”* pill below the nav links. The design tablet shows only the full-width top green banner; no inner-page pill is present.
- **Breadcrumbs visible:** The preview shows *“Products / Retatrutide”* breadcrumbs between the green pill and the page title. The design tablet does not display breadcrumbs.
- **Methodology badge container missing:** The design places the methodology elements inside a bordered rounded box with a dropdown chevron, and *“View methodology”* sits to the right of that box. The preview shows the text/pills inline without a containing border and places *“View methodology”* inline with the pills.
- **Subtitle copy / capitalization:** Design: *“methodology · Purity focus”*; Preview: *“methodology · Purity Focused”*.
- **Vendor table headers uppercase:** The preview renders table headers in ALL CAPS (*#, VENDOR, $/MG, CUSTOMER RATING, PURITY RATING, N*) on a light-gray background row. The design uses Title Case (*#, Vendor, $/mg, Customer Rating, Purity Rating, N*). The preview also lacks the populated data rows, showing an empty/error state instead.
- **Test history table missing rows:** The design shows a full table with headers (*DATE, RESULT, TEST, LAB, PURITY, DOSAGE*) and populated rows. The preview shows only the section header, stats, badge, and an error message.
- **COA badge iconography:** Design uses a green dot indicator; preview uses a document icon.

### Screen: `products-retatrutide-1440` (1440px)
- **Methodology badge layout & container:** The design places the methodology badge below the page-stats line, inside a white bordered rounded box with a dropdown chevron. *“View methodology”* sits to the right of the box. The preview floats the badge to the right of the page-title block, inside a light-gray rounded box, with *“View methodology”* inside the same box and no chevron icon.
- **Subtitle copy / capitalization:** Design: *“methodology · Purity focus”*; Preview: *“methodology · Purity Focused”*.
- **Vendor table headers uppercase & empty state:** The preview headers are ALL CAPS (*VENDOR, $/MG,* etc.) instead of Title Case (*Vendor, $/mg,* etc.). The preview also shows an empty/error state rather than the eight populated rows from the design.
- **Test history table missing:** The design shows a complete 8-column table (*DATE, RESULT, TEST, LAB, PURITY, DOSAGE, LABEL, COA*) with populated rows and green *“VIEW COA”* buttons. The preview shows only the section header, stats, badge, and an error message; no table columns or rows render.
- **COA badge iconography:** Design uses a green dot; preview uses a document icon.
